title: New Hunger Games Movie Keeps a Secret About Haymitch and Maysilee
summary:
The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping comes to theaters on November 20, 2026. It is from Suzanne Collins's 2025 book. The story follows Haymitch Abernathy, played by Joseph Zada, and Maysilee Donner, played by McKenna Grace, two tributes from District 12.

Director Francis Lawrence has directed every Hunger Games movie except the first. He spent a lot of time with Zada and Grace in rehearsals in Spain, talking about the pair. The three kept some secrets about the pair's bond to shape how the characters act.

One detail stands out: even though Haymitch and Maysilee have known each other all their lives, she slams the door in his face. Lawrence said Collins may not have written about other parts of their story.

Fans may know the pair from Catching Fire (2009), in which Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark watch footage of the 50th Games, where the pair teamed up against double the usual number of tributes. This time there are four District 12 tributes, not two. The youngest is Louella McCoy, protected by Haymitch since they were playground sweethearts.
why_it_matters: It can help you notice how friendships and secrets between characters shape the stories you watch.
